name: 双饮盖真空保温运动水瓶款
description: 吸管直饮一盖两用，双层真空锁温，细身进杯架，带提环好携带

styleLock.direction: performance-hydration gear suite: white studio proof system plus real daylight scene system, black caption bar as the typographic signature
styleLock.temperature: neutral-cool whites and steel; real scenes balance with natural warm sun
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF for packshots, macros and lineup; high-key sky #9DC0E4 with concrete #B4B8BC for the structure proof; real environments for scenes - dark car interior #33383D, blue-sky highland #85AFDC; every captioned frame carries the black #0A0A0B bottom banner
styleLock.lightingSystem: large top-left softbox with faint contact shadow for studio; natural hard midday sun outdoors with the sky as the key that rims the dark bottle; close diffuse for macros
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte powder-coated steel with fine grain, matte plastic lid, brushed stainless inner wall in cutaway views; environments stay matte (fabric seat, concrete, rock) with no mirror reflections
styleLock.typography: bold geometric sans-serif; white claim on the black banner plus a white pill tag, dark charcoal on white grounds; annotations are thin leader lines with dot terminals and very short words
styleLock.iconSystem: 1.5px thin-line single-color icon inside a thin circle at the left end of the caption bar, one icon per frame matching the claim
styleLock.presentationRules: one claim per frame; product always tack sharp at 12-50% occupancy, copy never sits on the product surface; models are generic faceless persons shown by torso and limbs only; colorways appear only in variant frames; light colorways staged against dark environments for contrast
noDrift: no second accent family beyond the palette
no brand logos, vehicle badges or screen UI
no caption text copied from the source
no studio-set hybrid backgrounds in scene frames
gradient colorways never dilute the hero's matte black-silver mood
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: performance-hydration e-commerce suite. Matte powder-coated steel bottle in deep charcoal #1E2126 (forest green #2E4A3A alternate) on seamless white #FFFFFF under a large top-left softbox with faint contact shadow; proof shots use high-key sky #9DC0E4 with brushed-steel #C9CDD1 inner-wall detail; scene shots use real daylight environments - dark car interior #33383D or blue-sky highland #85AFDC - with a black #0A0A0B bottom banner carrying one bold white claim, a white pill tag and a thin-line circle icon. One claim per frame, product always tack sharp, generic faceless persons only, colorways confined to variant frames, no logos, no kids prints, no second accent family.

shots.intent: 建立形态记忆：细长瓶身加双饮盖与提环
shots.camera: frontal eye-level with a 5-degree downward tilt, bottle centered slightly left, straw up, carry loop flipped open to the right breaking symmetry
shots.lighting: large left-front top softbox, faint right fill, soft even gradation on the matte body
shots.promptTemplate: {style_lock}. Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. Frontal eye-level with slight downward tilt: the slim matte charcoal bottle #1E2126 stands centered slightly left, straw upright, carry loop flipped open to the right, fine powder-coat grain visible with one soft vertical highlight. Large left-front top softbox, faint contact shadow. Seamless white #FFFFFF. Bottle occupies 50-60%. No overlaid text. 2K commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no brand logos or body prints, no hands, no condensation drops, no watermark, no glossy plastic look, no cut-off lid.

shots.intent: 把双层真空可视化为材料与工艺证据
shots.camera: eye-level with slight upward tilt, bottle at three-quarter on a concrete block, its outer shell peeled open like a scroll hanging at the left revealing the brushed inner wall, four thin leader lines running right to a short label column
shots.lighting: soft studio light from top-left, brushed steel highlights deliberately lit
shots.background: bright high-key sky with clouds #9DC0E4 to #E6EEF6, matte concrete block #B4B8BC
shots.props: peeled outer shell panel, concrete block pedestal
shots.promptTemplate: {style_lock}. E-commerce vacuum structure proof for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. Soft top-left light, deliberate steel highlights. High-key cloudy sky #9DC0E4 to #E6EEF6. Bottle system occupies 60-70%, right column 25-30%. Black banner #0A0A0B at the bottom with white claim, pill tag. 2K commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no invented insulation-hour numbers, no brand logos, no snowflake clip art, no watermark, no dents, no harsh shadows.

provenance.notes: 源自约 1.2 万评级的保温水瓶 listing；剥离瓶身猩猩 logo 与品牌字、包装盒环字与插画、车标与中控屏 UI、泳池派对与街头 banner 条、儿童印花与卡通独角兽款、另一塑料 Tritan 产品线；保温时长与防漏绝对化声明改为按真实规格呈现；渐变配色不入 hero 语法
